entries.en: now; at this moment

entries.zh: 就是现在；眼下立刻（今今仔）
entries.en: right now, just now; immediately
just now; only just
just now, a moment ago

entries.zh: 方才从……起（纔自，方才、从那时起）
entries.en: just since; ever since then
entries.notes: 「纔自」为副词连用，语义推断为『方才自/自那时起』。

entries.en: just arrived; has only just come
only now; just now at last
now, at present
at present; nowadays
at this very instant; on the spot
entries.notes: 闽南音写 nā̃ chéa 与对音 chiē chiē 不完全对应，或原稿有一字异写，据词头 agora en este punto 定为『当下』。

entries.en: up to now; until the present
thereupon; whereupon
now; nowadays
at present; for the moment, here before one
at the present time; presently

entries.zh: 目今；如今正是时候（目今）
entries.en: now, at present; now is the time
early in the morning; tomorrow morning (de mañana)

entries.zh: 渐渐成了；将就办成（初初成）
entries.en: it will now be finished; little by little it is done
entries.notes: 「初初成」叠字结构语义不够直观，据词头 agora se acabara 拟为『这就要办成/渐渐完成』。

entries.en: now I know it; only now do I know

entries.zh: 方方；刚刚、正当其时（方方）
entries.en: just now; precisely at this time
entries.notes: 「方方」叠字仅见于该词条，语义推断为『方才、恰好此刻』。

entries.zh: 方起来；这才起身/兴起（方起来）
entries.en: just now rising; it is but now getting up (or beginning)
entries.notes: 「起来」可指起身亦可指兴起，据 agora se lebanta 取『起身/起来』。
